complexity.time: O(epochs * n * T^2 * d_model) with T = min(d, max_tokens) tokens

strengths: Scores broken feature dependencies in a learned latent space; robust to unpredictable noise in raw features
Deterministic multi-mask inference; calibrated per-feature errors
SIGReg keeps normal embeddings isotropic-Gaussian: no EMA teacher, no collapse, one trade-off weight
Second complementary score (token-embedding Mahalanobis) from the same model
weaknesses: Needs >= 2 features and some inter-feature dependency to exploit
Slower than shallow detectors (transformer over feature tokens)
Transductive fitting Gaussianises training outliers along with inliers (like all unsupervised deep detectors)
JEPA.best_for: Medium-to-high dimensional tabular data whose anomalies violate joint feature structure rather than single marginals
JEPA.avoid_when: Very few features, tiny datasets (< 200 rows) or when a shallow detector already works

paper.short: LeCun 2022 (JEPA); Assran et al. CVPR 2023 (I-JEPA); Balestriero & LeCun 2025 (LeJEPA/SIGReg)

TSJEPA.full_name: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Time Series

complexity.time: O(epochs * n_windows * P^2 * d_model) with P = window_size / patch_len patches

strengths: Latent (not raw) prediction error of masked patches: ignores unpredictable noise, catches structural breaks
Bidirectional ('block') or causal ('forecast') masking; multivariate via channel-flattened patches
Patch-level embedding Mahalanobis score localises anomalies without temporal smearing
Deterministic inference (enumerated block masks), PyOD masked-score workflow
'pred' score is robust to operating-regime shift between training and test series (SKAB), unlike embedding-density scores
weaknesses: window_size must be a multiple of patch_len; needs a few thousand timestamps to train
Transductive fitting on long contaminated series can absorb an anomalous regime; keep the training budget small or fit on a cleaner segment
TSJEPA.best_for: Multivariate or noisy series with contextual / collective anomalies
TSJEPA.avoid_when: Very short series or when only simple spikes must be detected

paper.short: LeCun 2022; Ennadir et al. 2025 (TS-JEPA); Balestriero & LeCun 2025 (LeJEPA)
